title: Unavailable matchmaking, in-session transition, and restart evidence
action: failed or cancelled matchmaking, in-session server or shard transition, and AstraDock restart during active PU

sensitivityHandling.notes: No raw snippet is committed because the reviewed evidence does not contain complete controlled examples for these transitions.

expectedNonEvents.reason: No controlled terminal failure with an unambiguous local matchmaking request identity has been captured.
No distinct cancellation record has been captured; timeout, absence, or later join evidence is insufficient.
The same-shard DGS change was observed only through an overlay and has no safe game.log local-player correlation.
The second shard is observed after frontend return as a new PU session, not as an in-session shard transition.
No controlled AstraDock restart capture proves replay or bootstrap recovery during an active PU session.

correlation.notes: This manifest is a promotion gate. It prevents generic mesh/router vocabulary, missing terminal records, and startup reconstruction from becoming transition events.

knownLimitations: The unavailable scenarios require owner-supplied controlled captures before any positive event or reducer transition can be enabled.
Overlay/OCR observations are a separate future source and do not satisfy game.log evidence requirements.
verificationNotes: Fixture corpus validation must accept this annotation without a log file; future capture PRs must replace individual unavailable decisions with minimal sanitized positive and negative fixtures.
